fields.statement: rhiza inbox is the owner's one list of what waits on them across a repo's runs: questions with a recommendation, sign-offs and failed runs, with a Rex notification for each.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with fixture journals of a run blocked on a question, a run waiting at sign-off, a failed run and a done run lists exactly the first three in order in text and --json; once the question is answered, the sign-off approved and the failed run abandoned, rhiza inbox says nothing waits.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists, oldest first across every run of the repo, each item waiting on the owner with a short item ID: a question (its run, change set, session tab and the question), a run waiting at sign-off, and a failed run (its failed step and detail, until it is resumed or abandoned), in text and --json, and says so when nothing waits.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake Rex opens a question item and sees the asking session's tab focused, opens a sign-off item and sees the run's tab focused, and gets exit 2 for an unknown item.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox open <item> focuses the Rex tab of the session that asked a question, or of the run for a sign-off or a failed run, so the owner answers in the agent's own menu; an unknown item exits 2.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a review run waiting at sign-off approves it through its inbox item and finds the run done with an approved entry, sends another back with one finding and finds a fix cycle started, and gets exit 2 approving a question item; describe-golden is regenerated.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox approve <item> and rhiza inbox request-changes <item> <file> act on a sign-off item through rhiza run approve and rhiza run request-changes on that item's run, and exit 2 on any other kind of item.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake adapter whose agent blocks on a question finds an advisor launched with that question, its recommendation journalled and shown by rhiza inbox, no message sent to the asking session and the run still blocked; with a failing fake advisor the item shows no recommendation and the run is still blocked.
fields.statement: When a normal run blocks on a question, the engine launches a short-lived advisor session (the arbiter's guide in recommend-only mode) that reads slice and why for the question and journals a recommendation with its reasons, never answering it; the run does not wait for the advisor, the inbox shows the recommendation beside the question, and a failed advisor leaves the question without one.

fields.acceptance: With a fake Rex, a run that blocks on a question, then waits at sign-off, and another that fails, send exactly three notifications, one per item, and none while each item stays in the inbox.
fields.statement: Each new inbox item sends one Rex notification naming the change set and what waits (a question, a sign-off or a failed run), through the blocked-run notice path, and none again while the item stays.
